scope: Public-source feasibility review, not a platform endorsement or proof of buyer funding

platforms.access: Public issue query succeeded; authenticated contributor access not established
platforms.finding: One narrow open Bounty-labelled query returned an empty list. This does not establish that all GitLab projects lack bounties. Label discovery required authentication. The historical handbook proposal treats bounty terms as an agreement with the sponsor.
platforms.next_gate: Named sponsor, live issue, contributor permission and explicit BTC-mainnet payment agreement

platforms.fee: Official documentation says account use is free subject to terms
platforms.access: Official documentation read; repository browsing was blocked to the search tool; no authenticated account established
platforms.finding: Free software hosting is not a promise of paid contribution. No funded issue identified in the accessible material.
platforms.next_gate: Accessible specific project with independent funded sponsor and authorized submission route

platforms.fee: Official FAQ says applying/chatting has no fee and payments have no platform commission
platforms.access: Two live public buyer listings read; applications require sign-in and are private; no account accessed
platforms.finding: Direct settlement is negotiated. Both reviewed writing listings specify USDC or bank transfer, not an accepted BTC-mainnet agreement. GitHub sign-in is advertised but no login or authorization grant was attempted.
platforms.next_gate: Verified buyer accepting native BTC, precise scope, permitted authenticated application and eligibility

platforms.fee: Page advertises low fees; exact schedule not verified
platforms.access: Public page read; its job list reported a loading error
platforms.finding: Official page specifies Lightning wallet settlement. A mainnet address alone cannot receive that payout.
platforms.next_gate: Separately approved Lightning route or an explicit permitted native-mainnet alternative

platforms.fee: USD 15 crypto minimum; current net payout deductions not established
platforms.access: Official docs read; no authenticated, email-free application/claim route established
platforms.finding: Direct BTC wallet payments explicitly support Legacy and BECH32. Monetary awards require identity verification, payment setup and an approved tax form. Published setup and claim instructions involve email. A valid accepted finding is required; a program is not a guaranteed job.
platforms.next_gate: Permitted account/claim route, program-specific authorization, eligibility and independently accepted finding

platforms.fee: Detailed FAQ states 10% freelancer fees; premium marketing and rebate wording differ
platforms.access: Public official terms read; no account or wallet accessed
platforms.finding: Payment FAQ lists WBTC on Ethereum and BTCB on BNB Chain. Neither is native BTC mainnet. No approved conversion or alternate receiving route exists for this review.
platforms.next_gate: Explicit native-mainnet arrangement permitted by platform and buyer; resolve fee terms first
